summary: Announcement banner on a dithered gradient with a passing sheen; dismissing breaks it into dots that blow away before it collapses.

attributes.name: action
attributes.description: Label of the action button. An empty value hides the button. Observed.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Colour scheme: `ok` (green) or `warn` (amber). Without it the accent colour is used. Observed.

events.name: action
events.description: Fires when the action button is clicked.

events.name: dismiss
events.description: Fires when the disintegration ends and the collapse begins: about 0.95 s after dismissing, or at once with reduced motion.

methods.description: Plays the disintegration, then collapses the banner. Same as the dismiss button.
Restores a dismissed banner and replays the entrance.

accessibility: The dismiss button is a native button with `aria-label="Dismiss"`; the action button is a native button.
Dismissing makes the content `inert`, so its buttons leave the tab order and the accessibility tree; `show()` restores them.
motion: With reduced motion there is no entrance or sheen, the sparkle is static, and dismissing clears the canvas, emits `dismiss` and collapses the banner at once.

slots.name: title
slots.description: Heading text. Falls back to `Ultracode is here`.

slots.name: (default)
slots.description: Description text. Falls back to a sample sentence.

notes: The canvas extends 24px to the left, 72px to the right and 24px above and below the banner so the particles can leave it; an ancestor with `overflow: hidden` clips them.
